description: Start the full assembly line from your automation idea
usage_example: CA → describe what you want to automate
notes: Entry point for all new automations. Scout interviews you to capture requirements.

description: Chat with Scout about requirements or automation ideas
notes: Use for questions before starting a build.

description: Generate realistic test data from I/O specifications
usage_example: MK → generates mock inputs and expected outputs
notes: Covers happy paths and edge cases for thorough validation.

description: Chat with Blueprint about specifications and data schemas
usage_example: CH → ask about data format requirements

description: Find and compare available n8n nodes for a requirement
usage_example: ND → searches official and community node registries

description: Chat with Forge Master about n8n nodes and integrations
usage_example: CH → ask about platform support or node capabilities

description: Break a complex design into modular sub-workflows
usage_example: WD → splits into orchestrator + sub-workflows (max 10-20 nodes each)

description: Chat with Assembler about workflow architecture
notes: Documentation-obsessed — every node gets a sticky note.

description: Log patterns and learnings to ChromaDB knowledge base
usage_example: LC → extracts learnings from completed build and uploads
notes: System gets smarter with every build.

description: Chat with Foreman about project status and backlog
usage_example: CH → ask about blockers or progress
notes: Tracks everything — nothing falls through the cracks.

description: Push validated workflow JSON to your n8n instance
usage_example: DN → deploys via n8n API with credential placeholder instructions
notes: Includes human-in-the-loop steps for credential setup.

description: Chat with Welder about build progress
usage_example: CH → ask about node configuration or JSON output
notes: Follows specs exactly — no creative interpretation.

description: Run QA validation loop on a built workflow
usage_example: TV → tests every node's data flow; retries 3x on failure
notes: Never gives up — tries different approaches before escalating.

description: Propose different approaches when a test fails after retries
usage_example: AS → analyzes failure and ranks alternative nodes/approaches
notes: Checks user preferences to suggest compatible alternatives.

description: Chat with Inspector about test results
usage_example: CH → ask about specific test failures or validation status
notes: Reports with severity levels and remediation steps.

description: Check current progress on the assembly line
usage_example: WS → shows which agents completed and which are pending
notes: Available from any agent at any time.

description: Transfer context to the next agent in the assembly line
usage_example: HO → packages outputs and hands off to next station

description: Escalate a decision to the user for human judgment
usage_example: ES → presents options with trade-offs and waits for your input

description: Get help with AutoFlow commands and concepts
usage_example: HP → displays available commands and guidance
